# Conformance tests

Every test that carries a `// conformance:` marker, under each point and
track the marker names, grouped by file. A file marked (e2e) runs in the
e2e harness, with `FERROFED_E2E=1`, against the node products the
[conformance statement](conformance-statement.md) names. A point or track
with no marked test is not listed.
